item.description: POST /api/zombies/spawn and POST /api/zombies/{instanceId}/special-action are called by Game Service only. The Gateway refuses them (404 route_not_found), so the collection checks that, then sends them to zombie-service's queue in the message broker with a game-service token. Spawning picks real, weighted zombie types from /api/zombie-types; special actions are shaped by the instance's category and ability.

request.description: Only Game Service calls this route, through the message broker, so the Gateway must not forward it, whatever token the request carries (Lab 4: routes that must not be user available are removed from the Gateway).

item.name: Cache (Redis, sharded with consistent hashing)
item.description: Needs the 5.0.0 images. GET /api/zombie-types/{typeId} is cached in the team's Redis nodes, and a change to a type invalidates it. Run the compose with CACHE_DEBUG_HEADERS=true to check X-Cache (MISS / HIT), X-Cache-Node (the Redis node the consistent-hashing ring chose) and the Gateway's X-Auth-Cache; without them, those checks are skipped.
